root_cause.text: The function ip4ip6_err() passes a cloned skb whose control buffer (cb) contains IPv6-specific data (struct inet6_skb_parm) to icmp_send(), which incorrectly interprets it as IPv4 control buffer (struct inet_skb_parm), causing a type confusion that leads to a stack buffer overflow via __ip_options_echo() reading attacker-controlled IP option lengths from packet data.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and CVE description state: "ip4ip6_err() calls icmp_send() on a cloned skb whose cb[] was written by the IPv6 receive path as struct inet6_skb_parm. icmp_send() passes IPCB(skb2) to __ip_options_echo(), which interprets that cb[] region as struct inet_skb_parm (IPv4). The layouts differ: inet6_skb_parm.nhoff at offset 14 overlaps inet_skb_parm.opt.rr, producing a non-zero rr value. __ip_options_echo() then reads optlen from attacker-controlled packet data at sptr[rr+1] and copies that many bytes into dopt->__data, a fixed 40-byte stack buffer (IP_OPTIONS_DATA_FIXED_SIZE)." The patch clears the cb by zeroing IPCB(skb2) and adds IPv4 header validation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add safety checks and cleanup to prevent processing malformed or misidentified inner IPv4 headers in IPv4-over-IPv6 tunnel error handling.
intent_record.what: Added a memset to zero out IPCB(skb2) and added a check for inner IPv4 header version (==4) and IHL (>=5) in ip4ip6_err, jumping to out if invalid.
intent_record.how: Clears IP control block to remove leftover IPv6 stack data, then validates that the inner IP header is IPv4 with a minimum header length before proceeding with route lookup.
